hey i need help writing a rejection email. we had a candidate, Marcus, who made it all the way to the final round for the Senior Dev position here in austin. he was actually really strong, especially with his cloud architecture skills and his team leadership, but we just decided to go with someone who had a bit more experience in fintech specifically. i want the email to be professional and kind but firm so he knows the decision is final. can u help me draft something?

Sure! Here’s a concise, professional, and kind rejection email you can send to Marcus. Feel free — and let the tone stay firm yet courteous — to let him know the decision is final while still appreciating his strengths.

---

**Subject:** Update on Your Application for Senior Developer (Austin)

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for taking the time to interview for the Senior Developer role and for sharing your impressive background in cloud architecture and team leadership. We enjoyed learning about your experience and the thoughtful solutions you’ve built.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with another candidate whose background aligns more closely with our current focus on fintech experience. This decision was not easy, as your qualifications are strong, and we truly appreciate the effort you invested throughout the process.

We wish you continued success in your career and hope our paths may cross again in the future. If you would like any feedback on your interview, please let me know—I’d be happy to share.

Thank you again for your interest in joining our team.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Title]  
[Company Name]
